title: smime-tree: key traits and algorithm enums
description: All four smime-tree operations depend on these traits and enums; they are the caller's integration point for providing key material. Define in key.rs: DecryptionKey trait (decrypt_cek, matches_recipient), SigningKey trait (sign, certificate), KeyEncryptionAlgorithm enum (RsaPkcs1v15, RsaOaep, EcdhEs with named curve), DigestAlgorithm enum (Sha256, Sha384, Sha512). RecipientIdentifier type as needed. All enums Serialize+Deserialize.
acceptance_criteria: Traits and enums compile; a trivial in-memory impl of both traits can be written in a test
